versions.changelog:
## Uncraft Basics 1.0

First release.

- Take wool of all 16 colours apart into 4 string.
- Take quartz blocks, quartz pillars and chiseled quartz blocks apart into 4 nether quartz each.
- Take clay, snow blocks, glowstone, amethyst blocks, bricks, nether bricks, honeycomb blocks and dripstone blocks apart into the 4 pieces they are made of.
- Take blue ice apart into 9 packed ice and packed ice into 9 ice.
- 29 shapeless crafting recipes; every amount matches the vanilla recipe that makes the block, so nothing is ever gained.

## Uncraft Basics 1.1

Now also for Minecraft 26.3.

- The same zip works on Minecraft 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3: the recipes and their recipe book entries are included in the format each version reads.
- Same 29 recipes with the same amounts on every version, checked against the vanilla recipes of 26.3; nothing changes on 1.21 and 1.21.1.

## Uncraft Basics 1.2

Stone and glass.

- Stone bricks and chiseled stone bricks turn back into stone.
- Polished andesite, diorite and granite turn back into their plain stone.
- Polished deepslate, deepslate bricks, deepslate tiles and chiseled deepslate turn back into cobbled deepslate.
- Polished tuff, tuff bricks, chiseled tuff and chiseled tuff bricks turn back into tuff.
- Polished blackstone bricks and chiseled polished blackstone turn back into blackstone.
- Cut and chiseled sandstone (also red) turn back into sandstone, end stone bricks into end stone, purpur pillars into purpur blocks, polished basalt into basalt and mud bricks into packed mud.
- Quartz bricks give 4 nether quartz and chiseled nether bricks give 4 nether bricks.
- 8 glass panes give 3 glass.
- 26 new recipes, 55 in total. Every amount is what the cheapest vanilla recipe takes (one stone block back for one block, as in the stonecutter), so nothing is ever gained. Blocks made in a furnace (smooth stone, cracked bricks, terracotta) stay as they are.
- Works on Minecraft 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3 as before.

## Uncraft Basics 1.3

Copper, at every stage.

- 4 cut copper, 4 cut copper stairs, 4 chiseled copper or 4 copper grates give back 1 copper block, and 8 cut copper slabs give 1 block, as much as the stonecutter takes for them.
- 4 copper bulbs give back 3 copper blocks (the blaze rod and redstone are used up).
- The stage stays the same: exposed cut copper turns into an exposed copper block, oxidized grates into an oxidized block, and waxed blocks give waxed blocks.
- Copper doors give 2 copper ingots and copper trapdoors 3 (4 on 26.3, where a trapdoor takes 4 ingots), at every stage, waxed or not.
- Exposed, weathered and oxidized copper blocks (also waxed) give 9 copper ingots, like the plain copper block already does.
- Lightning rods give 3 copper ingots.
- 71 new recipes, 126 in total. Every amount is what the cheapest vanilla recipe takes, so you never get more copper or wax back than went in.
- Works on Minecraft 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3.
